intro: The Dolanaar Delivery is a package of harvested herbs sent from the druidic grounds of Shadowglen to the village of Dolanaar. Entrusted to young travelers leaving the sheltered glen, it serves as a simple errand to connect them with Innkeeper Keldamyr down the road.

p: Harvested within the shadowed groves of Aldrassil, this parcel contains fresh herbs gathered for the settlement of Dolanaar. Porthannius, detained by ongoing matters among the druids of Shadowglen, relies on fledgling adventurers bound southward along the road to ferry the bundle safely to Innkeeper Keldamyr.

Delivering the parcel brings the traveler straight to the threshold of Dolanaar's inn. Keldamyr receives the goods with gratitude, using the exchange to remind weary wayfarers of the necessity of rest, peace of mind, and the sanctuary offered by an inn's hearth before they venture deeper into Teldrassil.
